author: kokonutd
name: activity-card
description:
A versatile card component for displaying fitness and activity tracking data with interactive goals and metrics visualization.

Features

- Metric Rings
  - Circular progress indicators
  - Percentage-based visualization
  - Hover animations
  - Color-coded categories
  - Value and unit display

- Daily Goals
  - Interactive checkboxes
  - Completion status
  - Add new goals functionality
  - Visual feedback for completed items
  - Hover states

- Visual Elements
  - Category icon
  - Progress rings
  - Gradient dividers
  - Interactive buttons
  - Status indicators
